observations: body L1-L19: corrections to the text of the first volume, continued from p. XX; the page numbers at the margin are bold, and the n of «n. 7» (L1) is bold too.

body L1, L6-L7: «aṣ-Ṣūfī», «al-Bīrūnī», «Baily», «Ideler» and «Schjellerup» are letter-spaced. The last ī of «al-Bīrūnī» has a short macron (1.7 by 1.0 pt; the other macrons of the line measure 2.3-2.6 pt).

body L9-L14: the five lunar mansions for which Ideler and Schjellerup differ, each set from the paragraph indent, the names in italic; the numbers of Ptolemy's stars carry a raised a. The signs = are printed long (9.0-11.0 pt). «c′» and «c» (L12) are italic.
body L17: the minus signs are printed with the dash (10.1-10.2 pt); the plus sign is printed large.
body L18: the macron of «Īsà» is joined to the top of the italic I, which measures 8.4 pt in height, against 7.6 pt for the italic I of Introductorium on p. XIX.
body L20-L40: «Euclide», «Heronis Alexandrini», «an-Nayrīzī» and «Proclus Diadochus» are letter-spaced; the r of «Proclus» prints broken.

body L22-L30: the Latin version of an-Nayrīzī's commentary, quoted with its spellings (que, spheris, equalium, tocius); each line from L23 opens with a guillemet, and from «recipit» (L28) the quotation is italic, except «[sic!]». The sign = of «[= Īron,» is printed long (10.7 pt), with a fleck after it that is not transcribed.
body L31: a paragraph begins inside the entry.

body L33-L38: the κ of «ἀστρονομικὰ» is the open form of this type (ϰ). The ι of «οἱ» (L37) prints broken, like an exclamation mark, under the rough breathing. A small upright mark between the η and the ς of «στοιχειωτής» (L34) is not transcribed.
body L37: «utillimam» is transcribed as printed.
body L34, L39, L40: a dot above the E of «Elementorum» (L34), a dot above the a of «distantes» (L39) and a tick over the u of «secunda» (L40) are specks. The E of «Ea» (L39) prints broken.

notes_left L1-L6, notes_right L1-L6: three notes in two columns with a thin rule between them; note 2 runs from the left column into the right. «Anaritii» and «Procli-Diadochi» are letter-spaced; the hyphen of «Procli-Diadochi» is short (1.8 pt). The sign = of notes_right L2 is printed long (7.6 pt).

notes_left L1, L6, notes_right L1: dots under the r of «Anaritii» and the m of «decem» (notes_left L1) and under the i of «dis» (notes_left L6), and a dot above the G of «Godofredi» (notes_right L1), are specks.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
